data.description:
The Kleida Skin Lightening Moisturizer is formulated for all skin types and designed to deeply moisturize the skin while visibly brightening and evening out skin tone. It’s marketed as a complexion perfector that addresses pigmentation, dark age spots, tanning, and uneven tone issues .

Benefits & Key Claims

  • Brightens skin tone and helps achieve a more radiant, even complexion.
  • Reduces pigmentation, dark spots, and age-related spots.
  • Lightens tanning, ideal for post-sun care or pigmentation concerns.
  • Complexion perfector—gives skin a smoother, more luminous appearance.
  • Suitable for all skin types, with a “skin-friendly pH” and fragrance‑free formulation.

Key Ingredients & Their Roles

According to ingredient breakdowns sourced from Incidecoder and brand profiles, the formula includes:

  • Niacinamide (Vitamin B₃): A multifunctional ingredient that brightens skin, fades dark spots, strengthens barrier, hydrates, and offers anti‑acne benefits .
  • Salicylic Acid: A BHA exfoliant helping to unclog pores, calm inflammation, and treat acne or dark spots .
  • Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E): An antioxidant that helps nourish the skin and protect against oxidative stress .
  • Glycerin & Propanediol: Humectants that attract and retain moisture, supporting hydration .
  • Shea Butter Ethyl Esters & Caprylic/Capric Triglycerides: Emollients offering smooth, non-greasy texture and enhancing skin softness .
  • D‑Panthenol (Pro‑Vitamin B5): Soothes and hydrates skin, supports barrier repair .
  • Supporting agents like mattifying powders, stabilizers, and preservatives, ensuring safe, stable formulation (e.g. phenoxyethanol, benzyl alcohol, EDTA).

Usage & Application

  • Intended for daily use, typically after cleansing—apply a pea‑sized amount evenly across face and neck until absorbed .
  • Although marketed fragrance-free, best practice: start with patch testing if you have sensitive or acne-prone skin.

Ubiya Derma Skin Therapy Moisturizer Cream is a lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturizer that is enriched with marula oil, azelaic acid, vitamin E, and vitamin A. It is specially formulated for normal to oily and acne-prone skin to help hydrate, soothe, and protect the skin without clogging pores.

Explanation of ingredients and their benefits:

Marula Oil: Marula Oil is a natural moisturizer extracted from marula nuts. It’s packed with antioxidants and healthy fats that deeply hydrate your skin, leaving it soft and radiant.

Azelaic Acid: Azelaic Acid is a skin-brightening ingredient. It helps fade dark spots, evens out your skin tone, and can even tackle acne. It’s like a complexion corrector in a bottle.

Vitamin E: Vitamin E is a skin protector. It shields your skin from sun damage and pollution, keeping it healthy and resilient. Plus, it adds a dose of softness to your skin.

Vitamin A: Vitamin A is a skin rejuvenator. It stimulates collagen production, reducing wrinkles, and improving your skin’s overall texture. It’s like a mini-facelift in a serum.

How to use:

Cleanse your face using your preferred cleanser.
Apply a toner to prepare your skin for optimal moisture absorption.
Massage a small amount of Ubiya Skin Therapy Moisturizer Cream onto your face and neck.
Gently pat it into your skin for even distribution.
Use it morning and night as the final step in your skincare routine.

Safety guidelines:

  • This product is for external use only.
  • Avoid contact with eyes and mouth.
  • If irritation occurs, discontinue use.
  • Keep out of reach of children.

data.description:
Missha Airy Fit Sheet Mask Shea Butter sheet mask

The main ingredient of Missha Airy Fit Sheet Mask Shea Butter is shea butter. Shea butter moisturizes, soothes, regenerates the skin and also has an anti-inflammatory effect. It is quickly absorbed into the skin, has a long-lasting moisturizing effect, and stimulates the skin's self-healing ability. The "secret" of shea butter is that its composition is very similar to the composition of the natural emulsion that protects human skin, and its vitamin content makes it an almost perfect skin care product.

Shea butter in general
Shea butter is made from the fruit of the karité tree, a tree native to Central Africa. The karité tree produces its first large, plum-like, drupe-like fruits at the age of 20 and can bear fruit for up to 200 years. The harvested fruits have a fat content of 60-70%. The result of traditional processing is a medium-hard, off-white, sweet-smelling vegetable fat called shea butter. The extraordinary advantage of cold pressing is that shea butter can retain a very high content of vitamins A, E and F, and it does not contain any residues of the chemicals used for chemical extraction.
The beneficial effects of shea butter:
– Helps maintain skin elasticity
– Naturally nourishes and moisturizes the skin, reduces skin aging and the formation of wrinkles
– Has a regenerating and wound-healing effect
– Soothing ingredient
– ​​Shea butter soothes irritated skin after sunbathing –

It is recommended to perform a patch test before incorporating any new product into your regimen.   • Apply a small amount of the product onto a clean area of skin on the upper forearm.
  • Keep the area dry.
  • If the product has a specified duration of use, rinse off after this time has elapsed. Otherwise, rinse off after 24 hours.

data.description:
This serum is formulated as a daily treatment to address common concerns like dullness, dark spots, and uneven skin tone, delivering a brighter and more radiant complexion.

  • Sodium Hyaluronate (a form of Hyaluronic Acid):
    • Benefit: Provides intense hydration, plumping the skin and smoothing out fine lines.

  • Brightening: Restores a natural glow and tackles dullness, resulting in visibly brighter skin.
  • Spot Reduction: Effectively targets and reduces the appearance of dark spots, sun spots, and post-acne marks (hyperpigmentation).
  • Antioxidant Protection: Shields the skin from damage caused by pollution and UV exposure (when paired with sunscreen).
  • Collagen Support: Helps in boosting collagen production for improved skin firmness and elasticity.

📝 Product Characteristics

  • Texture: Typically lightweight, non-greasy, and fast-absorbing.
  • Suitability: Generally suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, due to the use of a stable and less irritating form of Vitamin C.
  • Formula: Often touted as fragrance-free and dermatologically tested.

💡 How to Use

  1. Cleanse your face thoroughly.
  2. Apply 2-3 drops of the serum onto your face and neck using the dropper.
  3. Gently pat and massage until fully absorbed.
  4. Crucially: Use this serum in your morning routine and always follow it with a broad-spectrum sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher) for maximum efficacy and protection.

data.description:
Depigmentation serum intensely brightens discolorations, spots, and color unevenness, prevents the formation of new ones and stimulates the skin's renewal process.

The innovative Melumin Tristage™ complex, included in the formula with patent application, acts in multiple directions through a synergistic combination of depigmenting ingredients:

Arbutin and Vitamin C inhibit the activity of tyrosinase, an enzyme essential in the process of melanin formation. Lightderm® inhibits growth and maturation of the melanosomes. Additionally,

Allantoin soothes the skin.

Discolorations of various etiologies, including sun-induced and post-acne, freckles, and irregular and/or dull skin tone
